catalogue_auditor.purpose: Identify missing, stale, or weakly supported product fields without inventing replacements.

source_policy_adviser.purpose: Produce a rights-aware refresh and consent queue; do not fetch, approve, or republish sources.

workflow_planner.purpose: Plan one content family against pinned product versions and the saved creative direction.

limitations: These are bounded deterministic workers, not live language-model agents.
No source collector, publisher, cloud renderer, or provider API is enabled by this registry.
Results are proposals, not source-policy approval, verified facts, or publication consent.
A profile recommendation does not switch the Codex conversation model.
